***Great investment opportunity for cash buyer*** 

This incredible apartment is being sold as a buy to let investment with a tenant in situ.

Situated in the iconic BBC Hull building. With the benefit of secure parking, two step out balconies overlooking The Queens Gardens, great transport links and good road connections to all parts of the city and beyond via A63/M62 motorway link.

This development offers the ultimate in city living, easy access to a wide range of local amenities including many restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance.
